en_us: New villages have house-workshops: the street south of the plaza has 2 homes of job households (3 in Valeholm), and one makes food. Valeholm workshops are Norse long houses, and Sunreach workshops are flat houses. Forges have no job sign.
fr_fr: Nouveaux villages : la rue au sud de la place a 2 maisons-ateliers de familles de métier (3 à Valeholm), dont une produit de la nourriture. Ateliers de Valeholm : maisons longues nordiques ; ateliers de Sunreach : maisons plates. Forges sans panneau de métier.
